episode_title: Avsnitt 100 del 2: Jubileum med tech-oraklet Storm Duncan

insights.quote: Technology is now a horizontal, which is every single company is now a tech company operating within a specific vertical, or else they will be disrupted and no longer be a part of the fabric of that sector in the future.
insights.summary: Technology has become essential across all industries; companies must adopt tech-first approaches or risk being disrupted.
insights.speaker: Storm Duncan

insights.quote: The more successful ones are the ones that see the problem and can't stop thinking about it... having a big enough ego to take the risk to start your company and to believe in what you're trying to solve. But having a small enough ego to be able to listen to your customers and to others so that you can adapt to it.
insights.summary: Successful entrepreneurship requires passion to solve problems combined with humility to listen and adapt based on feedback.
insights.speaker: Storm Duncan

insights.quote: If you're a company that is charging more for your product than your cost of producing that product, and you're growing rapidly, you should invest every ounce of profit and every ounce of capital you're able to raise in growing your company because you're creating something of value.
insights.summary: Positive contribution margin companies should reinvest profits for growth, while negative contribution margin businesses are unlikely to succeed.
insights.speaker: Storm Duncan

insights.quote: For me, I'm in finance, but my purpose is environmental. And so when I'm in finance and I'm out financing companies that I think are going to reduce the consumption of fossil fuels that are going to enhance the quality of our environment for future generations, I'm very comfortable with what I'm doing on a day-to-day basis.
insights.summary: Finding purpose beyond money—aligning your work with what you believe is good for the world—leads to greater fulfillment and success.
insights.speaker: Storm Duncan

insights.quote: Always know your passion, always know your light, always know what your purpose is and drive towards that. And you will be equally as successful but five times as happy.
insights.summary: Understanding and staying true to your purpose leads to both success and happiness in your career.
insights.speaker: Storm Duncan

insights.quote: If you find your purpose and you always give your clients or your partner the advice that's in their best interest for the long run, you will find that that will over the long run maximize the value of your firm because the profits of a repeat client that is loyal to you are always going to be higher.
insights.summary: Maintaining integrity and giving advice in clients' best interests creates long-term value and relationships.
insights.speaker: Storm Duncan

summary: Ett jubileumsavsnitt med Storm Duncan, global head of technology & M&A på Jefferies, som diskuterar teknologins genomslagskraft över alla sektorer, strategier för framgångsrika startups, SPAC-marknaden och vikten av att ha ett tydligt syfte i sitt arbete. Storm delar med sig av sina erfarenheter från stora M&A-affärer som YouTubes försäljning till Google.
key_takeaways: Teknologi är nu horisontell - alla företag måste vara tech-företag för att överleva
Lyckade startups drivs av snabb iterativ inlärning och fokus på problemet snarare än lösningen
Att hitta sitt syfte och leva efter sin integritet leder till både framgång och lycka
SPAC-marknaden har öppnat upp investeringsmöjligheter i tidiga tillväxtbolag för allmänheten
